# DeepSeek Agent Task Contract Template

> Copy this template and fill in the bracketed sections for each new task.

## Executor

DeepSeek Agent

## Working Directory

[full path to the git worktree where changes will be made]

The original repository at `[original-path]` must not be entered or modified.

**BLOCK-1 Path Enforcement**: The agent must verify BOTH:
1. `Get-Location` (or `pwd`) equals the contract-specified repository path.
2. `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` from the current directory returns the same path.
Even if SHA and branch match, a path mismatch = STOP immediately.

Agents are **forbidden** from using `git -C <path>` or `Set-Location` to
bypass the contract repository and operate in a different worktree.

## Formal Baseline

Branch: `main`
HEAD: `[full SHA]`
origin/main: `[full SHA]`

Before starting, the agent must verify:

```
Get-Location
git rev-parse --show-toplevel
git status --short --branch
git rev-parse HEAD
git rev-parse main
git rev-parse origin/main
git branch --show-current
```

All must match the baseline. Any discrepancy = STOP.

## Feature Branch

```
git switch -c [branch-name]
```

If the branch already exists, STOP. Do not delete, overwrite, or force-recreate.

## Task Scope

[Description of what this task should accomplish]

## Allowed Files

[Explicit list of files the agent may create or modify]

## Forbidden Operations

- Do not modify QuackQuota product logic, Rust business code, Tauri business
  code, or frontend functional code.
- Do not push, PR, merge, tag, or create releases.
- Do not modify `main` or any branch other than the feature branch.
- Do not delete or force-overwrite branches.
- Do not modify user configuration, registry entries, or installer logic.
- Do not run full product test suites when only tooling/docs change.

## Pre-start Checklist (Read-only)

- [ ] Current branch is `main`
- [ ] Working tree is clean
- [ ] HEAD = `[full SHA]`
- [ ] main = `[full SHA]`
- [ ] origin/main = `[full SHA]`

## Test Strategy

[List specific tests the agent must run and save raw logs for]

Example:
1. `git diff --check`
2. PowerShell Parser API syntax check on new `.ps1` files
3. `scripts/test-review-pack.ps1`
4. Format/link check on new docs

## Commitment Rules

- Only one local commit allowed.
- Commit message format: `[type]: [short imperative description]`
- Stage only the intended files; no Review.zip, logs, or temp directories.
- `git diff` must be self-reviewed before committing.

## Manual Acceptance

The human reviewer must:
- Run the desktop shell or CLI as needed
- Verify visual/behavioral changes
- Confirm the ZIP can be extracted and inspected

The agent cannot perform manual acceptance.

## Review Pack Generation

After the commit and clean status confirmation, the agent must run:

```powershell
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/create-review-pack.ps1 `
    -Repo "[repo-root]" `
    -Base "[baseline-SHA]" `
    -TaskName "[TaskName]" `
    -LogsDirectory "[path-to-logs]" `
    -TestSummaryPath "[path-to-test-summary.md]" `
    -OutputRoot "[path-to-output]" `
    [-PreviousHead "[previous-SHA]"] `
    [-ArtifactPath "[path-to-exe]"] `
    [-Force]
```

## Required Deliverable

A single ZIP file:

```
[OutputRoot]\QuackQuota-[TaskName]-Review.zip
```

## Task Completion Criteria

ALL of the following must be true before reporting "done":

- [ ] Final commit created on the feature branch
- [ ] Working tree clean (`git status --porcelain` empty)
- [ ] Contract-required tests run, raw logs saved
- [ ] `Review.zip` generated by `create-review-pack.ps1`
- [ ] Self-test (`test-review-pack.ps1`) passes
- [ ] ZIP SHA-256 printed in the final report

## Permission Boundaries

| Operation | Permitted |
|-----------|-----------|
| Create feature branch | Yes |
| Modify allowed files | Yes |
| Run targeted tests | Yes |
| Local commit | Yes |
| Generate Review.zip | Yes |
| Push | No |
| Create PR | No |
| Merge | No |
| Tag | No |
| Release | No |
| Delete branch | No |
| Modify main | No |
| Force push | No |
